profile.headline: Software Engineer at Facebook
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer and artist motivated by empowering users to feel safe and comfortable in digital spaces. I enjoy collaborating with designers and engineers to understand complex people problems and translate them into considerate and scalable solutions.

My personal hobbies include product photography, game design, and music composition. 
See my website portfolio for more about me!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- End to End encryption, Spam Folder, and other Well-being features on Messenger and Instagram
- Facebook design system UI infra, adoption, and tooling
- API modernization across Messenger, Instagram, and Facebook
- Managed productivity programs for the entire Messenger organization

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
Energy Team
• Full Stack Engineer
• Implemented systems to share accessible updates and alerts on changes in prices of energy resources

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Instagram Well-being Experience: Account Security
• Android Engineer
• Protecting Instagram users from malicious attempts of phishing, hacking, etc.

positions.title: Honors College Maker Space Technician
positions.description:
• Instruct students and peers on safe and proper conduct of machines including 3D printers, CNC routers, laser cutters, sewing machines, and smart vinyl cutters
• Use and teach skills involving CAD, circuitry, image editing, 3D modeling, etc.
• Developing a replica of ClockClock24 by Humans since 1982, using Arduino

positions.title: Junior Maker Coach
positions.description:
• Co-lead the "Teen Maker Institute" summer program
• Instructed class of 30 students (grades 6 – 12) to complete craft, technical or building projects
• Develop or refine project plans for the appropriate grade levels including learner-centered activities, resources/materials and opportunities for reflection

positions.title: Help Desk Level 2 Consultant
positions.description:
• Assisted and supervised Level 1 Consultant's calls by providing advanced knowledge and troubleshooting tips to reach resolution
• Took over calls too difficult for Level 1 Consultants, or calls approaching a half hour
• Attended to patrons in person with networking and software issues and other non-technical inquiries
• Followed-up on unresolved support tickets by resolving them or reaching out to users in question
• Addressed issues received through e-mail with complete instructions for issue resolution
• Bypassed 802.1x incompatible devices on to Rutgers' wired network

positions.title: Beta Application Support Consultant
positions.description:
• Monitored critical Rutgers University computing infrastructure, servers, services and networks by using Nagios and console checks of the machine room
• Collaborated with Rutgers TD NOC to escalate and resolve system and network outages
• Ensured security and environmental stability of the Hill Center Data Center
• Provided after-hour support to Rutgers affiliates when the Help Desk is closed at night

positions.title: Help Desk Level 1 Consultant
positions.description:
• Provided prompt and courteous technical phone assistance available to over 65,000 members of the Rutgers staff, faculty, and student body
• Created accurate, detailed support tickets documenting troubleshooting steps and results
• Resolved issues related to university services, networking issues, and general difficulties using electronic devices
• Assisted supervisors and full-time staff in 'special projects' related to OIT internal affairs

honors.title: Dean's List
honors.description: Awarded for maintaining a 3.500 or better GPA per semester of full-time students (12.0+ credit)
honors.issuer: Issued by Rutgers School of Arts and Sciences · Dec 2017

honors.title: Trustee Scholarship
honors.issuer: Issued by Rutgers University - The State University of New Jersey · Jan 2016

volunteerExperiences.description: Guided a Year Up mentee in their transition to a new technical role, offering professional and technical expertise. Provided valuable assistance in career planning and resume development.

Participating in the Relay For Life allowed me to dedicate my resources to the American Cancer Society to support their research. I was introduced to individuals affected by cancer, whether as survivors or friends and family members, and honor those whose bodies have passed but memories have not.

projects.title: Personal Website
projects.description:
Personal website displaying my various portfolios for:
• Photography
• Software projects
• Game development
• 3D Art

projects.title: Robot Farm
projects.description:
"Robot Farm" is a lighthearted pixel-art game about friendship, featuring farming, creature collection, and classic JRPG gameplay in a vast world that can be played in and made by the players.
Created using our NNGINE (custom game 2D & 3D game engine built using LWJGL3 API)

organizations.name: Rutgers Commuter Student Association (RCSA)
organizations.position: Secretary (Mar 2018- Present) • IT Student Advisory Board representative (2018 - Present) • Events Chair (Jan 2018 - Mar 2018) · Jan 2018 - Present
organizations.description:
• Collaborate with Rutgers staff and faculty in order to organize, plan and host events for the Rutgers student and administrative population
• Relay questions concerns of the 15,000+ commuter student population to Rutgers Office of Information Technology directors and affiliates to reach solutions and new initiatives
• Prepare and distribute minutes for bi-weekly e-board meetings, and oversee minutes for bi-weekly committee meetings
• Prepare and maintain the official membership and active voting membership of RCSA
• Write and send listserv e-mail to 7,000+ people for all affairs related to RCSA and commuter/off-campus life
• Maintain and update inventory for the RCSA office holding both internal and public resources

organizations.name: Rutgers University Science, Math & Engineering Outreach (RUSMEO)
organizations.position: Treasurer (2018 - present) • Engineering Governing Council representative (2017 - 2018) · Sep 2017 - Present
organizations.description:
• Organize and plan events to encourage K-12 students across New Jersey to explore STEM
• Host events on campus to work with children in hands on STEM projects
• Participate in fundraising and promotional opportunities for the club
• Manage society funds for outreach projects, trips, and inventory
